title: Useful Gilded Blackstone
description: This makes gilded blackstone which is one of the rarest blocks in the game more useful by allowing it to be smelted into a gold block in a furnace.
body:
# ARCHIVED! YOU MAY REQUEST AN UPDATE ON MY DISCORD BELOW
### GENERAL DESCRIPTION
This data pack simply allows you to smelt gilded blackstone into gold blocks in a furnace or a blast furnace, finally making the block even rarer than ancient debris a lot more useful.

### INSTALLATION GUIDE
go to your saves folder located here on Windows:
```
C:\Users(your name)\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\saves
```
put the zipped file in the data packs folder, and either restart your world or execute /reload
